This markup syntax is called JSX. It is a JavaScript syntax extension popularized by React. Putting JSX markup close to related rendering logic makes React components easy to create, maintain, and delete.

React has idioms — or rules — for how to express patterns in a way that is easy to understand and yields high-quality applications:

Components and Hooks must be pure – Purity makes your code easier to understand, debug, and allows React to automatically optimize your components and hooks correctly. React calls Components and Hooks – React is responsible for rendering components and hooks when necessary to optimize the user experience. Rules of Hooks – Hooks are defined using JavaScript functions, but they represent a special type of reusable UI logic with restrictions on where they can be called.
